name: - Sheep
fix_description: In _burn, also subtract the corresponding rAmount from _rTotal (not just _tTotal). Currently only _tTotal is reduced, causing the reflection rate (_rTotal/_tTotal) to inflate, which increases all holders balances artificially.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a very short, direct interaction with a single vulnerable contract and no flash loans, routing, or cross-protocol logic. It appears to abuse straightforward game/accounting logic by repeated registration plus a few state-changing calls, which a competent auditor could reproduce quickly.
